title: 08/04/17 - Software Updates
text:
## 08/04/17 - Software Updates
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000033479
We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website.

## Updates:
We improved the Admin Account Page save functionality in the Site Admin in order to provide a better navigation experience.
We made an update to improve the functionality of the Advanced Setting years_field_start_year. It is now working as expected.
